_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic#8. Both halves of the claim executed on the biphasic template: a <material> with only id= gives 'tag "material" (line N) : missing attribute "name"', and a <NodeSet> written with <n id=.../> children gives 'tag "NodeSet" (line N) : invalid value:'. Each message is required ABSENT from the other run so neither half is satisfied by the wrong trigger. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'name_attr_and_nodeset=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
